verdict.rationale: Firecrawl ships its own built-in AI agent. Users describe what they need in natural language, and the agent searches, navigates and retrieves the data without URLs. Users can also set how much reasoning it spends, and agent jobs are first-class jobs with webhook notifications. Delegation is limited to web data retrieval, not a general in-product assistant, and the evidence is mostly brief README lines. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the agent's task scope and limits, delegation beyond web research/retrieval, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task quality

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what you need, and our AI agent searches, navigates, and retrieves it. No URLs required.
Set how much reasoning the agent spends on the task
Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes.
